title: HardTVAE: Hardness-Aware Tabular Variational Autoencoders
summary: Companion code for a paper on hardness-aware VAEs that inject instance-hardness weighting into VAE training to generate synthetic minority-class data for imbalanced tabular learning, evaluated against TVAE and CTGAN baselines with a multi-view fidelity and utility protocol. SDV's CTGANSynthesizer (via sdv.single_table) is instantiated, fit and sampled as a baseline generator, and sdmetrics' KSComplement/TVComplement are called directly for distributional fidelity scoring.
